params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a stylized 3D adventure RPG seen from a high three-quarter top-down gameplay camera, about 55 degrees. A small chibi engineering student with dark curly hair, utility jacket, cargo pants and a crossbody tool bag walks up a stair street with a small cat wearing a glowing cyan collar tag beside them; both are small in frame, about one tenth of the image height. Hillside neighborhood of colorful houses in Guayaquil, Ecuador, late afternoon: tin roofs, hanging power lines, laundry lines, potted tropical plants, a large ceibo tree, an iguana sunbathing on a wall, a street lamp, mosaic stairs, a glimpse of the wide river below. Long warm sunlight, cool teal shadows. Art style: stylized low-poly 3D, crisp faceted geometry with flat-shaded planes, hand-painted gradient texture on each facet, cel-shaded light with a bright rim light, chunky simplified forms, clean silhouettes, matte materials, cohesive palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and a cyan accent. No text, no logos, no interface.
